LiftPegUpright-v1.instruction: grasp the red-and-blue peg lying flat on the table, lift it, and stand it upright on one end

PegInsertionSide-v1.instruction: grasp the orange-and-white peg, align its orange tip with the square side hole in the tan box, and insert the peg into the hole

PickCube-v1.instruction: pick up the red cube and move it to the visible green spherical goal marker above the table

PlugCharger-v1.instruction: grasp the white charger plug, align its two prongs with the white receptacle slot, and insert the charger into the socket

PokeCube-v1.instruction: grasp the blue peg, use its tip to poke the red cube, and push the cube into the red-and-white circular target

PullCube-v1.instruction: pull the blue cube backward until it sits inside the red-and-white circular target on the table

PullCubeTool-v1.instruction: grasp the red L-shaped tool, hook it behind the small blue cube, and pull the cube back into the robot's reachable workspace

PushCube-v1.instruction: push the blue cube across the table until it reaches the red-and-white circular target

PushT-v1.instruction: use the stick end-effector to push the red T-shaped block until it overlaps the gray T-shaped target pose

RollBall-v1.instruction: push and roll the blue ball across the table into the red-and-white circular target area

StackCube-v1.instruction: pick up the red cube, place it directly on top of the green cube, and release it so the stack remains stable
